I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, not the date she posted in #north-team this morning, and that I wouldn't take any other action, as she asked.

A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to mention in that channel. I didn't need to read any other channels to do this.
